Definisi : f. ( preceded by indef article ), [ repeat noun in Malay ], [ not translated ]: that’s a difficult ~ to answer, itu soalan yg sukar dijawab; this knife is a good ~ for cutting bread with, pisau ini bagus utk memotong roti; g. Definisi : c. Definisi : b. Definisi : if you’re looking for a legal firm, I know ~ that charges reasonably low fees, jika kamu sedang mencari firma guaman, saya tahu sebuah yg mengenakan yuran yg agak rendah; is there a doctor on board? We need ~!, ada doktor dlm kapal terbang ini? Kami memerlukan seorang!; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : with ~ voice, a. simultaneously, dgn suara serentak: with ~ voice they all shouted “Long live the Queen!”, dgn suara serentak, mereka semua berteriak “Daulat Tuanku!”; b. also with ~ accord, unanimously, dgn sebulat suara: the members voted for the new regulation with ~ voice, para ahli mengundi menyokong peraturan baru itu dgn sebulat suara; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : for ~ thing she’s hardly ever there, dia tdk dapat diharapkan; pertamanya dia hampir tdk pernah ada; for ~ thing the car is too expensive, and for another I don’t like the colour, pertama, kereta itu terlalu mahal, kedua, saya tdk suka warnanya; neither ~ (thing) nor the other, ini pun bukan, itu pun bukan: most plays can be labelled tragedies, comedies, satires and so forth, but Everett’s latest production is neither ~ thing nor the other, kebanyakan drama dapat disebut tragedi, komedi, satira dan seterusnya, tetapi produksi Everett yg terbaru, ini pun bukan, itu pun bukan; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
